material_findings.title: Life After Code - GitLab Transcend Hackathon
material_findings.entry_cost: No purchase/payment required by official rules; compute/hosting costs not independently verified
material_findings.prizes: USD 45,000 aggregate cash: Path A $4k/$4k/$5k; Path B $4k/$4k/$5k; special $5k x2, $5k, $4k; one path prize plus one special prize max per project
material_findings.eligibility: Adults, qualifying individuals/teams/organizations; USA not listed as excluded. Geographic and promotion-entity restrictions apply; participant-specific status unverified.
material_findings.requirements: Register on Devpost and as GitLab contributor (about 24 business hours approval); use GitLab Duo Agent Platform; Path A new work after Oct 5 or Path B prior MIT-licensed project with new automation after Oct 5; public MIT-licensed GitLab repository, visible pipeline, working demo and public YouTube video under 3 minutes. Path B requires deployed public project until about Nov 16.
material_findings.verification: Directly reviewed organizer-managed Devpost official rules Sections 1,3,4,8 and event overview Oct 24. No signup, cloud account, build, submission or payout verified.
material_findings.next_action: Immediately check registration and GitLab contributor approval feasibility, GitLab Duo access, repository license and 72-hour implementation feasibility; do not claim the existing cipher suite is MIT licensed without checking. If feasible, build a separate authorized entry and structured case; otherwise retain as time-limited watch.

material_findings.submission_window: 2026-10-23 10:00 Pacific to 2026-11-02 14:00 Pacific (organizer schedule lists Nov 2 PST)
material_findings.entry_cost: No purchase/payment required by official rules; developer-tool, API and hosting costs not verified
material_findings.prizes: USD 25,000 total cash: first $10k, second $6k, third $4k, two runner-up $2.5k. In-person TwitchCon travel is not required to retain monetary prize; winners pay their own travel if attending.
material_findings.eligibility: Individuals 18+ or age of majority, teams; U.S. generally eligible subject to exclusions, sanctions and promotion-entity conflicts. Organizations not eligible.

Prize subject to verification and taxes.
material_findings.verification: Directly reviewed official Devpost rules Sections 1,3,4,8 and official event overview Oct 24. No registration, Codex access, Twitch account or live integration verified.
material_findings.next_action: Check available Codex access and Twitch API/EventSub development constraints, account registration, demo hosting cost and time budget. Create an isolated new project only if requirements can be met; do not reuse pre-Oct 23 work as new.

material_findings.title: USA.gov xTech Kinetic Reach active-lifecycle vs closed application
material_findings.summary: USA.gov advertises $1.5M in cash and an overall Nov 30 end date, but the Army organizer explicitly says submission window is closed and Phase 1 ran June 5-30. November is a finalist soldier exercise, not an open application window. Eligibility requires an established eligible business and TRL 6+ capabilities.
material_findings.next_action: Keep discovery listing but mark application closed; do not promote $1.5M as presently accessible prize money or create a new active case.
